## Specification

### Component: Tabs

Switch between views in place. One indicator element glides between the triggers.

#### Anatomy
```
<Tabs variant orientation activationMode value|defaultValue onValueChange>   div.ui-tabs
  <TabsList>                       div.ui-tabs-list role="tablist" (position: relative, scrolls)
    <TabsTrigger value>            button.ui-tabs-trigger role="tab" data-value
    span.ui-tabs-indicator         ONE element, role="presentation" aria-hidden
  <TabsContent value forceMount?>  div.ui-tabs-content role="tabpanel" tabIndex 0
```

#### Props
- `Tabs`: `value`, `defaultValue`, `onValueChange`; `variant` (`segmented` default | `underline` | `pills`); `orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`); `activationMode` (`automatic` default | `manual`).
- `TabsTrigger`: `value` (required), `disabled`. `TabsContent`: `value`, `forceMount` (keep hidden panel mounted).

#### Behaviour
- Inactive panels are not rendered unless `forceMount`. Ids come from `useId()` + a sanitised value; `aria-controls` is set only on the selected trigger (its panel exists).
- Roving tabindex: selected trigger `0`, others `-1`; if none is selected the first enabled trigger is `0`.
- Keyboard (APG): arrows along the orientation (wrapping), Home/End, disabled triggers skipped. `automatic`: focus selects. `manual`: Enter/Space selects (native button click). No typeahead.
- Indicator (`useIndicator`): in a layout effect measure the selected trigger (`offsetLeft/Top/Width/Height`) and write `--ui-tab-x/y/w/h` on the list; set `data-ready` after the first measure and `data-animate` two animation frames later. Re-measure on value change and with a ResizeObserver on the list and its children. If the list overflows, scroll the selected trigger into view horizontally (never the page).
- Before `data-ready` (SSR, first paint) the selected trigger carries the highlight itself, so nothing jumps when the indicator appears.
- Panels animate in only after the first value change (`data-interacted` on the root).

#### Visual rules
- List: no wrap, `overflow-x: auto`, scrollbar hidden. Trigger 14px/500, `--ui-muted-foreground`, selected `--ui-foreground`.
- Segmented: list padding 3px, gap 2px, `--radius-lg`, `--ui-surface-muted` track; trigger 30px high, 14px padding; indicator `--ui-surface-raised`, `--radius-md`, `--ui-shadow-sm` + 1px `--ui-border-subtle` ring (dark: foreground 14% over the track).
- Underline: gap 4px, 1px `--ui-border` line along the list (inset shadow), trigger 40px high 12px padding; indicator 2px `--ui-primary` at the bottom (vertical: at the inline end).
- Pills: gap 4px, trigger 32px, fully rounded; indicator `--ui-accent`; selected text `--ui-accent-foreground`.
- Vertical: list is a column (segmented 192px wide), panel to the right with 24px gap.
- Panel: no outline; focus ring `0 0 0 3px` ring 45%.

#### Motion
- Indicator: `transform`, `width`, `height` on `--ui-spring-morph` / `--ui-spring-morph-duration`; none on first render; reduced motion jumps.
- Panel: `ui-rise-in` 220ms `--ui-ease-out` (only after interaction).

#### Accessibility
- WAI-ARIA tabs pattern. `aria-orientation` on the tablist; give the list an `aria-label` when its purpose is unclear.

#### Acceptance checks
- The indicator box matches the selected trigger box after every change (also after resize and when scrolled).
- Arrow/Home/End keys move and select; manual mode needs Enter/Space; disabled tabs are skipped.
- Narrow screen: the list scrolls and the selected tab is visible.

### `ui/components/tabs/tabs.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useId,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type MouseEvent,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useComposedRefs } from '../../lib/compose-refs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useIndicator } from '../../hooks/use-indicator';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from '../../hooks/use-isomorphic-layout-effect';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';

export type TabsVariant = 'segmented' | 'underline' | 'pills';
export type TabsOrientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
export type TabsActivationMode = 'automatic' | 'manual';

interface TabsContextValue {
  value: string;
  setValue: (value: string) => void;
  baseId: string;
  variant: TabsVariant;
  orientation: TabsOrientation;
  activationMode: TabsActivationMode;
}

const TabsContext = createContext<TabsContextValue | null>(null);

function useTabsContext(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(TabsContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Tabs>.`);
  return ctx;
}

/** Ids must be valid for aria-controls / aria-labelledby whatever the value looks like. */
const slug = (value: string) => value.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/g, '_');

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface TabsProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  /** Controlled selected tab. */
  value?: string;
  /** Initially selected tab when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string;
  /** Called when the selected tab changes. */
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /** `segmented` (raised pill on a track), `underline` or `pills`. Default `segmented`. */
  variant?: TabsVariant;
  /** Arrow keys move along this axis. Default `horizontal`. */
  orientation?: TabsOrientation;
  /** `automatic` selects a tab as it gets focus; `manual` waits for Enter or Space. Default `automatic`. */
  activationMode?: TabsActivationMode;
}

/**
 * Tabs — switch between views in place. One indicator glides between the
 * triggers; keyboard follows the WAI-ARIA tabs pattern.
 */
export const Tabs = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TabsProps>(function Tabs(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue = '',
    onValueChange,
    variant = 'segmented',
    orientation = 'horizontal',
    activationMode = 'automatic',
    className,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const baseId = useId();
  // Panels animate in only after the first change, never on page load
  const [interacted, setInteracted] = useState(false);
  const first = useRef(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (value !== first.current) setInteracted(true);
  }, [value]);

  return (
    <TabsContext.Provider value={{ value, setValue, baseId, variant, orientation, activationMode }}>
      <div
        ref={ref}
        className={cn('ui-tabs', className)}
        data-orientation={orientation}
        data-variant={variant}
        data-interacted={interacted ? '' : undefined}
        {...props}
      />
    </TabsContext.Provider>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export const TabsList = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function TabsList(
  { className, children, onKeyDown, ...props },
  forwardedRef,
) {
  const ctx = useTabsContext('TabsList');
  const listRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const ref = useComposedRefs(forwardedRef, listRef);

  useIndicator(listRef, '[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]', ctx.value);

  // Roving tabindex: when nothing is selected, the first enabled tab stays reachable
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const list = listRef.current;
    if (!list || list.querySelector('[role="tab"][aria-selected="true"]')) return;
    list.querySelector<HTMLElement>('[role="tab"]:not(:disabled)')?.setAttribute('tabindex', '0');
  });

  const roving = useRovingFocus({
    itemSelector: '[role="tab"]',
    orientation: ctx.orientation,
    typeahead: false,
    onMove: (item) => {
      if (ctx.activationMode === 'automatic' && item.dataset.value !== undefined) ctx.setValue(item.dataset.value);
    },
  });

  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="tablist"
      aria-orientation={ctx.orientation}
      data-variant={ctx.variant}
      data-orientation={ctx.orientation}
      className={cn('ui-tabs-list', className)}
      onKeyDown={(e) => {
        onKeyDown?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) roving(e);
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      <span className="ui-tabs-indicator" role="presentation" aria-hidden="true" />
    </div>
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface TabsTriggerProps extends Omit<ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>, 'value'> {
  /** Ties this trigger to the TabsContent with the same value. */
  value: string;
}

export const TabsTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, TabsTriggerProps>(function TabsTrigger(
  { value, className, onClick, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useTabsContext('TabsTrigger');
  const selected = ctx.value === value;
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type="button"
      role="tab"
      id={`${ctx.baseId}-trigger-${slug(value)}`}
      data-value={value}
      aria-selected={selected}
      aria-controls={selected ? `${ctx.baseId}-content-${slug(value)}` : undefined}
      data-state={selected ? 'active' : 'inactive'}
      tabIndex={selected ? 0 : -1}
      className={cn('ui-tabs-trigger', className)}
      onClick={(e: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) ctx.setValue(value);
      }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

/* -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */

export interface TabsContentProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement> {
  /** Shown while the trigger with the same value is selected. */
  value: string;
  /** Keep the panel in the DOM (hidden) while inactive, to preserve its state. */
  forceMount?: boolean;
}

export const TabsContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TabsContentProps>(function TabsContent(
  { value, forceMount = false, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const ctx = useTabsContext('TabsContent');
  const selected = ctx.value === value;
  if (!selected && !forceMount) return null;
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="tabpanel"
      id={`${ctx.baseId}-content-${slug(value)}`}
      aria-labelledby={`${ctx.baseId}-trigger-${slug(value)}`}
      data-state={selected ? 'active' : 'inactive'}
      hidden={!selected}
      tabIndex={0}
      className={cn('ui-tabs-content', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-indicator.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useEffect, type RefObject } from 'react';
import { prefersReducedMotion } from '../lib/dom';
import { useIsomorphicLayoutEffect } from './use-isomorphic-layout-effect';

/**
 * A single highlight element that glides between the items of a container.
 * Measures the active item and writes `--ui-tab-x/y/w/h` on the container; CSS
 * moves one indicator with a transition. The container gets `data-ready`
 * after the first measurement (so SSR markup never jumps) and `data-animate`
 * two frames later (so the first placement is never animated).
 * The active item is scrolled into view horizontally when the container scrolls.
 *
 * @param containerRef positioned (position: relative) container that holds the items and the indicator
 * @param selector     selects the active item inside the container
 * @param key          changes whenever the active item changes
 */
export function useIndicator(containerRef: RefObject<HTMLElement | null>, selector: string, key: unknown) {
  useIsomorphicLayoutEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    const measure = () => {
      const active = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
      if (!active) {
        container.removeAttribute('data-ready');
        return;
      }
      const style = container.style;
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-x', `${active.offsetLeft}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-y', `${active.offsetTop}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-w', `${active.offsetWidth}px`);
      style.setProperty('--ui-tab-h', `${active.offsetHeight}px`);
      container.setAttribute('data-ready', '');
    };
    measure();
    // Bring the active item into view when the list scrolls
    const active = container.querySelector<HTMLElement>(selector);
    if (active && container.scrollWidth > container.clientWidth) {
      const left = active.offsetLeft - 8;
      const right = active.offsetLeft + active.offsetWidth + 8;
      if (left < container.scrollLeft || right > container.scrollLeft + container.clientWidth) {
        const target = left < container.scrollLeft ? left : right - container.clientWidth;
        container.scrollTo({ left: target, behavior: prefersReducedMotion() ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
      }
    }
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver(measure);
    ro.observe(container);
    for (const child of Array.from(container.children)) ro.observe(child);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, [containerRef, selector, key]);

  // Turn the transition on only after the first placement has painted
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;
    let raf2 = 0;
    const raf1 = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      raf2 = requestAnimationFrame(() => container.setAttribute('data-animate', ''));
    });
    return () => {
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf1);
      cancelAnimationFrame(raf2);
    };
  }, [containerRef]);
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/compose-refs.ts`

```ts
import { useCallback, type Ref, type RefCallback } from 'react';

type PossibleRef<T> = Ref<T> | undefined;

function setRef<T>(ref: PossibleRef<T>, value: T | null) {
  if (typeof ref === 'function') ref(value);
  else if (ref) (ref as { current: T | null }).current = value;
}

/** Merge several refs into one callback ref. */
export function composeRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  return (node) => {
    for (const ref of refs) setRef(ref, node);
  };
}

/** Memoised composeRefs for use inside components. */
export function useComposedRefs<T>(...refs: PossibleRef<T>[]): RefCallback<T> {
  // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  return useCallback(composeRefs(...refs), refs);
}
```

### `ui/lib/dom.ts`

```ts
/** True when rendering on the server (no DOM). */
export const isServer = typeof window === 'undefined';

/** Resolve once every animation on `el` (and its subtree) has finished. */
export function animationsFinished(el: Element | null, subtree = true): Promise<void> {
  if (!el || typeof el.getAnimations !== 'function') return Promise.resolve();
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    // Wait a frame so animations triggered by the state change have started.
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      const anims = el.getAnimations({ subtree });
      if (!anims.length) return resolve();
      Promise.allSettled(anims.map((a) => a.finished)).then(() => resolve());
    });
  });
}

export function prefersReducedMotion(): boolean {
  return !isServer && window.matchMedia?.('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches === true;
}
```

```css
/* Tabs --------------------------------------------------------------------
   <div class="ui-tabs" data-variant="segmented|underline|pills" data-orientation>
     <div class="ui-tabs-list" role="tablist">          scrolls when it overflows
       <button class="ui-tabs-trigger" role="tab" aria-selected>

     <div class="ui-tabs-content" role="tabpanel">
   JS writes --ui-tab-x/y/w/h on the list; data-ready appears after the first
   measurement and data-animate two frames later (first placement never animates).
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-tabs { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1rem; }
  .ui-tabs[data-orientation="vertical"] { flex-direction: row; align-items: flex-start; gap: 1.5rem; }

  .ui-tabs-list {
    position: relative;
    display: flex;
    flex: none;
    max-width: 100%;
    overflow-x: auto;
    overflow-y: hidden;
    scrollbar-width: none;
    -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
  }
  .ui-tabs-list::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-orientation="vertical"] { flex-direction: column; overflow: visible; max-width: none; }

  .ui-tabs-trigger {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    flex: none;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 0.5rem;
    white-space: nowrap;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    font-weight: 500;
    line-height: 1.25rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    cursor: pointer;
    user-select: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
    transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard), background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-tabs-trigger[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-tabs-trigger:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
  .ui-tabs-trigger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-tabs-trigger:not(:disabled):hover { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }

  /* The one indicator */
  .ui-tabs-indicator {
    position: absolute;
    left: 0;
    top: 0;
    z-index: 0;
    width: var(--ui-tab-w, 0px);
    height: var(--ui-tab-h, 0px);
    transform: translate(var(--ui-tab-x, 0px), var(--ui-tab-y, 0px));
    opacity: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-ready] .ui-tabs-indicator { opacity: 1; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-animate] .ui-tabs-indicator {
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      width var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      height var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph);
  }

  /* ---- segmented: raised pill on a muted track ---- */
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="segmented"] {
    gap: 2px;
    padding: 3px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-lg);
    background: var(--ui-surface-muted);
  }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="segmented"][data-orientation="vertical"] { width: 12rem; max-width: 100%; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="segmented"] .ui-tabs-trigger { height: 1.875rem; padding-inline: 0.875rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md); }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="segmented"][data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-tabs-trigger { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="segmented"] .ui-tabs-indicator {
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm), 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-border-subtle);
  }
  .dark .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="segmented"] .ui-tabs-indicator,
  [data-theme-mode="dark"] .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="segmented"] .ui-tabs-indicator { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-foreground) 14%, var(--ui-surface-muted)); }

  /* ---- underline: a bar under (or beside) the active tab ---- */
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="underline"] { gap: 0.25rem; box-shadow: inset 0 -1px 0 var(--ui-border); }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="underline"][data-orientation="vertical"] { gap: 0; box-shadow: inset -1px 0 0 var(--ui-border); min-width: 10rem; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="underline"] .ui-tabs-trigger { height: 2.5rem; padding-inline: 0.75rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md) var(--radius-md) 0 0; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="underline"][data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-tabs-trigger { justify-content: flex-start; padding-inline-end: 1.25rem; border-radius: var(--radius-md) 0 0 var(--radius-md); }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="underline"] .ui-tabs-indicator {
    height: 2px;
    transform: translate(var(--ui-tab-x, 0px), calc(var(--ui-tab-y, 0px) + var(--ui-tab-h, 0px) - 2px));
    border-radius: 2px 2px 0 0;
    background: var(--ui-primary);
  }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="underline"][data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-tabs-indicator {
    width: 2px;
    height: var(--ui-tab-h, 0px);
    transform: translate(calc(var(--ui-tab-x, 0px) + var(--ui-tab-w, 0px) - 2px), var(--ui-tab-y, 0px));
    border-radius: 2px 0 0 2px;
  }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-animate][data-variant="underline"] .ui-tabs-indicator {
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      width var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph),
      height var(--ui-spring-morph-duration) var(--ui-spring-morph);
  }

  /* ---- pills: a soft fill behind the active tab, no track ---- */
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="pills"] { gap: 0.25rem; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="pills"] .ui-tabs-trigger { height: 2rem; padding-inline: 0.875rem; border-radius: 999px; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="pills"][data-orientation="vertical"] { min-width: 10rem; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="pills"][data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-tabs-trigger { justify-content: flex-start; }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="pills"] .ui-tabs-indicator { border-radius: 999px; background: var(--ui-accent); }
  .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="pills"] .ui-tabs-trigger[aria-selected="true"] { color: var(--ui-accent-foreground); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-tabs-list[data-variant="pills"] .ui-tabs-trigger[aria-selected="false"]:not(:disabled):hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-accent) 55%, transparent); }
  }

  /* ---- before the indicator is measured (SSR / first paint): style the active trigger itself ---- */
  .ui-tabs-list:not([data-ready])[data-variant="segmented"] .ui-tabs-trigger[aria-selected="true"] {
    background: var(--ui-surface-raised);
    box-shadow: var(--ui-shadow-sm), 0 0 0 1px var(--ui-border-subtle);
  }
  .ui-tabs-list:not([data-ready])[data-variant="underline"] .ui-tabs-trigger[aria-selected="true"] { box-shadow: inset 0 -2px 0 var(--ui-primary); }
  .ui-tabs-list:not([data-ready])[data-variant="underline"][data-orientation="vertical"] .ui-tabs-trigger[aria-selected="true"] { box-shadow: inset -2px 0 0 var(--ui-primary); }
  .ui-tabs-list:not([data-ready])[data-variant="pills"] .ui-tabs-trigger[aria-selected="true"] { background: var(--ui-accent); }

  /* ---- panels ---- */
  .ui-tabs-content { outline: none; border-radius: var(--radius-md); min-width: 0; flex: 1 1 auto; }
  .ui-tabs-content:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }
  .ui-tabs[data-interacted] > .ui-tabs-content[data-state="active"] {
    animation: ui-rise-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Account settings** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/tabs/account.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from '@/ui/components/tabs';

const field = 'h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 text-base outline-none focus:border-ring';

export default function TabsAccount() {
  return (
    <Tabs defaultValue="account" className="w-full max-w-md">
      <TabsList>
        <TabsTrigger value="account">Account</TabsTrigger>
        <TabsTrigger value="password">Password</TabsTrigger>
        <TabsTrigger value="sessions">Sessions</TabsTrigger>
      </TabsList>
      <TabsContent value="account" className="grid gap-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-medium">Account</h3>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Make changes to your profile. Click save when you are done.</p>
        </div>
        <label className="grid gap-1.5 text-base font-medium">
          Name
          <input className={field} defaultValue="Ada Lovelace" />
        </label>
        <label className="grid gap-1.5 text-base font-medium">
          Email
          <input className={field} type="email" defaultValue="ada@atlas.dev" />
        </label>
        <Button className="justify-self-start">Save changes</Button>
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent value="password" className="grid gap-4 rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5">
        <div>
          <h3 className="font-medium">Password</h3>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">Use at least 12 characters. You will be signed out on other devices.</p>
        </div>
        <label className="grid gap-1.5 text-base font-medium">
          Current password
          <input className={field} type="password" autoComplete="current-password" />
        </label>
        <label className="grid gap-1.5 text-base font-medium">
          New password
          <input className={field} type="password" autoComplete="new-password" />
        </label>
        <Button className="justify-self-start">Update password</Button>
      </TabsContent>
      <TabsContent value="sessions" className="rounded-xl border border-border bg-card p-5">
        <h3 className="font-medium">Active sessions</h3>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">3 devices are signed in: MacBook Pro, iPhone 15 and Chrome on Windows.</p>
      </TabsContent>
    </Tabs>
  );
}
```
